title_uk: Half of US aid to Ukraine was funneled back to the Democratic Party through FTX

origin.origin_note_en: The claim surfaced on a laundering site presenting itself as independent financial analysis, then spread through US political accounts in late 2022.

confirmations.finding_en: Independently assessed this narrative as false and published a rebuttal.

label: Aid funnelled to a US party
false_claim: Half of US aid to Ukraine was funneled back to the Democratic Party through FTX
canonical_debunk: Ukraine did use a crypto exchange to process public donations, and that exchange's founder was separately a large political donor in the United States. Both facts are true and unrelated; the claim manufactures a link between them.
